# C&A Advisory Services

> Based in India. Serving clients across India and internationally.

International services: accounting, bookkeeping, cleanup and setup, CFO/FP&A, reporting, financial modeling, model review and transaction support.

India services: Income Tax, GST, company and LLP compliance, import-export and customs documentation, accounting and financial advisory. Registration, filing, changes and closure support.

Abhishek Sachdeva, FCA, and Chahat Kathpal, Finance & International Tax Professional. Historical client work and feedback retain their professional attribution.
